description: Resolves an ENS name to its address, or an address back to its primary ENS name, reading Ethereum mainnet directly. Names are what humans paste and addresses are what chains need. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

address.description: Address to reverse-resolve. Use instead of name.

name.description: ENS name to resolve, such as vitalik.eth.

name: evm_ens
title: ENS name resolution
